rationale.execution: The pipeline consists of two sequential ABINIT runs (optimization and DFPT) with dependencies, plus output parsing. Environment setup (ABINIT, pseudopotentials) and multi‑file input generation add moderate orchestration, but overall neither trivial nor very long/complex.
